title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform for High Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
abstract: arXiv:2608.08163v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. translated_title: 智能体AI驱动的沉浸式仿真：面向高剂量率（HDR）近距离放射治疗的知识感知虚拟训练平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08163v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：元宇宙与基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体的融合，正在推动医学教育向自主化、沉浸式和个性化的教学框架转变。本文提出了一种新颖的智能体AI驱动的沉浸式仿真系统，专门针对癌症诊疗中的高剂量率（HDR）阴道圆柱体（VC）近距离放射治疗而设计。通过整合虚拟现实（VR）与移动计算，该系统构建了一个高保真、无风险的训练环境，使学员能够掌握复杂的操作技能，而不受实体解剖结构或活体放射源所带来的设施条件与安全限制的约束。本工作的核心贡献在于无缝集成了一个知识感知助手，利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术将智能体的交互内容锚定于权威临床指南之上。该架构还支持交互式智能体提供自然语言界面以及免提（操作）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个融合虚拟现实、移动计算与基于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识感知AI智能体的沉浸式仿真平台，为高剂量率（HDR）阴道圆柱体近距离放射治疗提供无风险、锚定权威临床指南的虚拟培训环境。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an agentic AI-driven immersive simulation platform that integrates VR, mobile computing, and a knowledge-aware RAG-based assistant to provide risk-free virtual training for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder brachytherapy grounded in authoritative clinical guidelines.
